title: Constant-coefficient finiteness for projective smooth curves
statement:
Let $S$ be Noetherian
and let $f:X\to S$ be
projective and
smooth, with geometric fibres
of pure dimension one. If $\ell$ is a prime invertible on $S$,
every higher direct image
$R^rf_*\mathbf F_\ell$ is
constructible.

proof.text: Projectivity supplies IsProper f via IsHProjective.isProper. The constant module sheaf with value ULift (ZMod ell) has finite geometric stalks, since its stalk is the finite coefficient module itself. Apply geometricFiber_finite_stalk_formula to the canonical algebraic-closure point of each base point and take the isomorphism given by its explicitly transported base-change map. Pullback of a constant module sheaf is constant by upperStarConstantSheafIso.

Forget the coefficient action on the resulting fibre-cohomology isomorphism. Apply nonempty_etaleModuleCohomology_forgetIso and constantCommuteCompose to identify the result with abelian cohomology of the fibre constantZMod sheaf. The private proved helper constant_prime_stalk_equiv composes these actual isomorphisms and returns an equivalence of underlying types.

Map the unit assumption through the evaluation map from global sections to each residue field. Apply projective_curve_betti_cardinalities, with the resulting nonzero residue-field prime, to obtain a natural-number-valued cardinality function b and constructible level sets. Its Cardinal.mk equality, transported by the helper equivalence, proves actual finiteness of every canonical geometric stalk as well as its Nat.card equality. The definition algClosurePoint is exactly the geometric point used by the Betti lemma.

Compare an arbitrary separably closed geometric point with the canonical algebraic-closure point over the same base point using exists_geometricStalkComparison_constant. The comparison transfers finiteness to every geometric stalk, hence gives IsFiniteSheaf of the higher direct image. Apply the source library module-valued realization of fin4-lem-stalk-constructibility-criterion, Scheme.isConstructibleSheaf_iff_isConstructible_card in WeilConjectures.ConstructibleSheaf.Noetherian. Rewriting the stalk Nat.card by b gives its constructible-cardinality-locus premise. Finally isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff_isConstructibleSheaf identifies this constructibility predicate with the unchanged conclusion. The module-valued criterion avoids an extra abelian-stratum-to-module-stratum conversion.
